beats.subline: Friday, November 6, 2026 close — stocks closed out a losing week, dragged down by Thursday's AI-chip-driven selloff despite a Friday rebound in tech shares.
beats.body: Friday's bounce in chip and AI-infrastructure names like Nvidia and Micron trimmed losses but wasn't enough to offset Thursday's steep AI-spending-driven selloff; all three indexes finished the week lower, with the Nasdaq hit hardest and the Dow holding up best. Markets were closed over the weekend and resume Monday, with the delayed October CPI report due Tuesday.

beats.headline: US formally extends pause on China chip-export 'Affiliates Rule' through January 2027
beats.body: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security published a final rule extending its suspension of the sweeping 'Affiliates Rule,' which would require licenses for chip and tech exports to firms 50%-or-more owned by blacklisted Chinese entities; the move, tied to the US-China trade truce, pushes the rule's scheduled reimposition from November 10, 2026 to January 10, 2027.
beats.source: Federal Register / Bureau of Industry and Security
